input_text: Picture a black hole as a seed pod. Collapse inside the pod reaches the proposed bounce and opens into a baby universe. At fixed compactness—how tightly the starting matter is packed—the parent's mass enters the map on screen. The arrow leads to the baby's starting size and heat. This is the inheritance channel the papers actually calculate. This paper also contains no plots—the entire argument is equations. The parent's rotation arrow stays outside the map. So does any fingerprint survive for long?
